prs.title: fix(ui): fix html reporter crash when --bail cancels files
prs.author: hi-ogawa
prs.body:
- closes https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11689

When building the module graph, the HTML reporter assumed `TestModule.viteEnvironment` is always set. But that assumption is wrong for test files that never reached a worker, for example files that `--bail` cancels before they start. This PR fixes it by skipping those files, so they show up in the report with an empty module graph.

Other places already handle this case, and only the HTML reporter missed it:

- packages/vitest/src/node/core.ts#L1116-L1120
- packages/ui/client/composables/client/static.ts#L43-L47

prs.title: fix(browser): keep failure screenshot per attempt
prs.author: hi-ogawa
prs.body:
- closes https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11614

When a browser test failed on several retries, every attempt wrote its failure screenshot to the same file, and the reporter output listed that file under every attempt's error.

This PR saves failure screenshots of tests with `retry` or `repeats` as `<test>-<repeat>-<retry>.png`, like trace files. Tests without them are still saved as `<test>.png`.

In the reporter output, errors and screenshots are now matched by attempt, so each error lists only the screenshot of the attempt that produced it.

---

For the repro in the issue (a test with `retry: 2`), the reporter output changes like this (diff and code frame omitted):

Before:

```
 FAIL  |chromium| basic.test.ts > retried
AssertionError: expected 1 to be 10
Failure screenshot:
  - .vitest/attachments/failure-screenshots/basic.test.ts/retried.png
⎯⎯⎯[1/3]⎯
 FAIL  |chromium| basic.test.ts > retried
AssertionError: expected 2 to be 10
Failure screenshot:
  - .vitest/attachments/failure-screenshots/basic.test.ts/retried.png
⎯⎯⎯[2/3]⎯
 FAIL  |chromium| basic.test.ts > retried
AssertionError: expected 3 to be 10
Failure screenshot:
  - .vitest/attachments/failure-screenshots/basic.test.ts/retried.png
⎯⎯⎯[3/3]⎯
```

After:

```
 FAIL  |chromium| basic.test.ts > retried
AssertionError: expected 1 to be 10
Failure screenshot:
  - .vitest/attachments/failure-screenshots/basic.test.ts/retried-0-0.png  👈
⎯⎯⎯[1/3]⎯
 FAIL  |chromium| basic.test.ts > retried
AssertionError: ex
…(truncated)

prs.title: fix(browser): print trace timeline of each attempt
prs.author: hi-ogawa
prs.body:
- follow-up to https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/11594
- stacked on https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/11694

The trace timeline per-attempt printing is broken by the same reason as failure screenshot. This PR fixes one deferred test case `prints trace timeline of the last retry` from https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/11594.

prs.title: fix: keep syntax highlighting in code frames
prs.author: sheremet-va
prs.body: `truncateString` stripped ANSI colors even when the line fit, so code frames lost syntax highlighting (regressed in #10170).

prs.title: fix: respect CLI filters when prewarming browsers
prs.author: sheremet-va
prs.body:
CLI file filters are now passed into config resolution, so browser projects without matching files are not prewarmed. Based on #11530.

Fixes #11546

prs.title: fix: read cached source as utf-8 (fix #11682)
prs.author: juan-fernandez
prs.body:
Prepared with AI assistance for @juan-fernandez, who reviewed the code and description.

Fixes #11682.

Read cached server modules as UTF-8 so Vite receives source text and stack formatting preserves the original error.

Regression coverage checks cached and uncached modules, UTF-8 text, and TypeScript source-map locations. Verified with Vite 8.0.11 and 8.3.5, including Node 24 and 26 reproductions.
